images.alt: A diagram of two nested loops: a small loop circles a robot at a desk, and a much larger loop around it runs through pinned screenshots, a shelf of procedure cards, and small figures making corrections.
images.prompt: Two nested loops of arrows, seen straight on and centred. The inner loop is small and tight, circling a single robot at a desk. The outer loop is many times larger and passes through a wall of pinned paper screenshots on the left, a long shelf of bound procedure cards on the right, and a row of small human figures marking corrections along its lower arc. The size contrast between the two loops is the subject. Keep everything well inside the frame; the centre crop is 16:9.
